plan.summary: BRO-4914 leftovers after bro-4914-b: let the Stage and Cinema Evita review (US critic at the London Palladium) through the cross-market guard, and fix the Musical Theatre Review Evita byline (Jeremy Chapman) and date (2025-07-03).
steps: BRO-4914 item 5: Stage and Cinema (US outlet) sent Michael M. Landman-Karny to the London Palladium Evita (url stageandcinema.com/2025/07/16/evita-london-palladium/; stored text names the Palladium, Zegler and the balcony staging). The rebuild's forward cross-market guard drops every non-trade US outlet on a London show, so the BRO-4914-b ingest landed wrongProduction; this per-review marker lets it through.
